objective: Dispatch one prioritized Hunter queue across ChatGPT Deep Research, ChatGPT Work, and Claude Co-Work/Research as admitted research engines, minimizing unnecessary research calls and protecting Todd's interactive capacity. The engine never changes the research standard, schema, or validation. Routing, reserves, and Capacity Watch pacing are defined in research/hunter_orchestrator_config.json and enforced by scripts/hunter_orchestrator.py.

execution_order.rule: Always perform before any model or web-research call.
Admitted and enabled. No reserve applies; remaining allowance is tracked locally and reported as unknown unless observed.

use_for: same assignment and packet standard as Deep Research
execution_order.rule: Admitted. Enabled only after a capacity snapshot is recorded and reviewed. Dispatch respects its daily, weekly, and short-window reserves.

use_for: same assignment and packet standard as Deep Research
execution_order.rule: Admitted. Enabled only after a supported capacity signal and dispatch path are verified. Dispatch respects its reserves.

use_for: schema failure that cheaper tiers cannot repair
execution_order.rule: Exception only; record the escalation reason and do not repeat work already completed by a cheaper tier.

capacity_scope.chatgpt_deep_research: Local execution ledger only. No reserve. Remaining allowance is unknown unless a real observable signal exists; never infer a count.
capacity_scope.chatgpt_work: Daily and weekly reserves start at 60% each for Todd's development and day-to-day work; Hunter may use the remainder. The CoS adjusts reserves from observed run-outs and unused capacity, within configured bounds.
capacity_scope.claude_co_work: Same reserve model as ChatGPT Work. Capacity is recorded manually until a supported signal is verified.
capacity_scope.burn_down: In the final 24 hours before a reset, reserves drop to the emergency level so expiring capacity is released to queued work. After-hours (18:00 America/Chicago) allows accelerated dispatch while burn-down is active.
capacity_scope.capacity_watch: A pacing control, not an engine: pause, slow, normal, or accelerate, read from the Capacity Watch signal file.

codex_work_capacity_gate.note: The former Codex/Work gate treated Work as a non-engine. Work is now an admitted engine governed by reserves in research/hunter_orchestrator_config.json.

batch_rule: Calling functions determine Chat research cycle size. Recommended sizes improve focus and call efficiency but are not capacity gates.
